name: Four Wellsprings and class archetypes
anchor_quote: ## **IV. Four Wellsprings & Their Class Archetypes** Below, each Primal Wellspring is paired with every Focus to form a specific “class” name and role. Think of these as the *first tier* of Confluences—how raw Wellspring current + Focus anatomy/psyche produce a distinctive archet
rules_overview: A character-building framework. Two focus types (Corporea and Essentia), six named foci in each, and four wellsprings (Divine, Eldritch Shadow, Arcane, Valor). Crossing a focus with a wellspring names a class archetype and gives a one-line role. Section V tells the reader to brainstorm signature abilities. This inventory does not treat those names as written classes.
notes: Child records are the named archetypes. They have no level table in this source.

name: Season 5 character creation
setting: Arcania / Roanoke Season 5 (Legends), published Google Site
anchor_quote: Character Creation As you make your character, keep in mind that revivify is banned this year (with the exception of Savage Fertility clerics).
rules_overview: Published player-facing creation rules. Revivify is banned except for Savage Fertility clerics. Stats are rolled only on the official server. Three difficulties (Tenderfoot, Aces, Desperado) change XP, stat method, and death saves. After difficulty: background, then a required Life Path (Miner, Rancher, or Gambler), then race from an approval list, then class. No multiclass. Start at level 6. mechanics.text: Normal XP. Point buy, or rolled with an optional mulligan for stats under ten. Normal death saves.

mechanics.name: Aces

mechanics.text: 1.5 XP bonus. Rolled stats placed in the order rolled. No reroll. You may only save from death once. The next time you are downed, you are dead. If rezed, the death save is not replenished.
